description: Phase 4 multimodal dev dataset: a small, deterministic fixture built directly against backend/tests/fixtures/study_notes.docx (real Docling parsing/chunking) plus a synthetic silent WAV (audio pipeline plumbing only). Image and transcript chunk_ids/content were produced with MOCKED VLM/OCR/transcription providers (backend/scripts/build_multimodal_eval_dataset.py) — no real LLaVA/tesseract/Whisper model is available in this environment, matching the Phase 2 HyDE-mocked precedent (see docs/research/reproducibility.md). This proves the ingestion->chunk->retrieval pipeline is wired correctly end to end for every modality; it is not a measurement of real VLM/OCR/Whisper quality. Regenerate with backend/scripts/build_multimodal_eval_dataset.py if the fixture changes.
